# N3 handoff after inactive N2 — review required

N2 is a private disposable lifecycle/read host, explicitly imported from `ItacanTaskCore/host`. It is absent from production construction and native-core/F1/F2 entry points. The single production Task Service remains Legacy Adapter → Markdown/metadata authority. No actual native vault root is configured or initialized.

N2 adds queued scoped `TaskRepository.readSnapshot`, read-time storage observation checks, explicit private-v4 root admission, a storage-free N0 projection and an authoritative private F2 evidence provider. Public host APIs expose no execute/import/export/migration operation. General N0 History and legacy Statistics remain unsupported. See the N2 verification report and sealed execution evidence before proposing any expansion.

Writer admission, command routing, live owner/location/identity coordination and production subscriptions remain N3 work. The host's process-local directory pin and cooperative lock do not provide cross-device uniqueness, hostile-writer protection or cloud rollback guarantees. Opening may persist existing recovery barriers but never initializes, converts, substitutes or downgrades an authority. Stopped-flat schema4 remains forensic-only. No fence-clear, lock-break or pointer-repair API exists.

The proof provider joins selected current task/Step state, parent binding, event and actual creation receipt within one queued validated native capture, bracketed by injected owner/identity pins. Native receipt order proves native publication order only. It does not prove durable Oath enrollment order across independent Oath saves. Preserve F2's conservative unknown result for ordinary/restored references and its explicitly closed synthetic positive sequence. Provider restart, changed context, reopening and uncertain recovery cannot reconstruct a lost enrollment witness.

Any durable enrollment intent, acknowledgment reconciliation, persisted native Oath-reference extension or unsaved-latch repair requires separate N3 review and real interruption tests. Do not add another outcome/task/planning authority or infer missing events from absent receipts. Parent-only commitments and whole scheduled/active committed-tree deferral remain established, including already latched active Oaths. Recurrence commitments remain pinned to one occurrence and its current event.

The injected registry is not a second owner store or a live lease. Hosting its production observation/invalidation boundary needs review. Physical Resource ownership remains independent of mounts into either shared Project. Project status, root/dashboard, sharing approval, current location and historical attribution remain distinct. Missing context is unavailable, not an empty list or reassignment.

Private generations, aliases, N1-C originals, raw History, import receipts, Oath/Strict/device state and recovery evidence remain private. Existing serializer/repository export guards remain mandatory. N2 DTOs are local reads, not N4 sharing packets. Prior legacy broad metadata selection and out-of-root captureSource exposure remain unresolved production findings; they grant no native export permission.

Use a fresh sequential baseline, exact allowlist and saved explicit test inventories for any later gate. Preserve independent data/workspace/Markdown drift without restoration. Stage builds only in guarded OS Temp, verify the unchanged startup authority and preserve real crash/lock evidence. N4 transport, N5 rehearsals, N6 activation and N7/N8 removal/UI remain separately authorized. STOP FOR USER REVIEW; no N3 implementation is authorized by this handoff.
